context: Tests whether the pair skill enforces strict mode by never producing production code, declining requests to 'just write the code,' using Socratic questioning, and maintaining strictness under user pressure.

checklist.name: Strict mode set
checklist.description: Strict mode is acknowledged and confirmed active in the session initialization

checklist.name: No production code
checklist.description: No production code is written at any point — only questions, verbal guidance, and code review

checklist.name: Pushback declined
checklist.description: The 'just write it for me' request is declined with acknowledgment and teaching redirection

checklist.name: Socratic questioning
checklist.description: Guiding questions are used throughout instead of providing direct answers

checklist.name: Strictness persists
checklist.description: Strictness level is maintained after user pressure without downgrading to collaborative mode
